purpose: Run a cosmic-ray propagation code from a JSON run spec in a recorded environment and turn each run into one grid-node prediction (representation grid, the node in parameter_point) that the comparison gate and covariance_fit.py model tabulated-grid consume unchanged; translate a transport block (contracts ext_theory_spec.transport) into a USINE V3.5 run with every inexpressible item recorded, read USINE's local-flux tables into ratios of bin integrals, and serve USINE as the cr-provider/1 provider 'usine'; translate a transport block into a DRAGON2 run with every inexpressible item recorded and serve DRAGON2 as the cr-provider/1 provider 'dragon2' (ratios of bin integrals on ekn or rigidity bins); optional, required by no skill

tools.name: DRAGON2 (https://github.com/cosmicrays/DRAGON2-Beta_version): run spec to XML and data directory, local-spectrum ASCII output to bin-averaged ratio predictions and to ratios of bin integrals (provider dragon2)
tested_versions: DRAGON2-Beta_version git cd588707fe03c76f19bda1b8092e136dcbe3fe90 (2021-09-30; configure.ac DRAGON 3.1.0), built 2026-10-15 on E2 with Homebrew GCC 15.2.0, GSL 2.8, CFITSIO 4.6.4 (autoconf 2.72, libtool 2.6.2): six runs recorded (B/C with convection, reacceleration, energy losses and decay off; illustrative production cross sections) and replayed offline (VALIDATION CR-PROPAGATION-DRAGON2)

the same build on E-crprop (macOS 27.2 arm64), 2026-10-28: five cr-propagation D1 item runs translated from harmonized-v1-<item>.json (item-off, convection, decay with NUBASE2020 half-lives, reacceleration, energy losses) recorded and replayed offline, convection and decay compared with the B2 closed form, reacceleration and losses with USINE V3.5 (VALIDATION CRPROP-D1; D1-1 fails its 3% tolerance, with attribution; the energy-loss run is unphysical, an open issue); the provider passes C1's conformance checks live (HEP_DRAGON2_LIVE_TEST=1)

tools.name: USINE (https://gitlab.com/dmaurin/USINE, GPL-2.0, run as a separate program): transport block to initialisation file and cross-section tables, local-flux tables to ratios of bin integrals (provider usine)
tested_versions: USINE V3.5 (git tag V3.5, tag object 7197ddc1, commit fb53006db41d1a640bf1b5af1a4b0f899ca59673), built 2026-10-28 on E-crprop (macOS 27.2 arm64) with Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.0.123.102) against Homebrew ROOT 6.38.04 (C++17), cmake 4.3.2: seven runs translated from transport blocks (harmonized-v1 and the D1 items isotopic, convection, decay, reacceleration, losses, and a 1D run with a low break) recorded and replayed offline; a live rerun (HEP_USINE_LIVE_TEST=1) reproduces every recorded output within relative 1e-6; the provider passes C1's conformance checks live (VALIDATION CRPROP-B1)

environment: E2 (docs/capability-matrix.md): macOS 26.5 arm64, Python 3.13.2 with numpy 2.5.3 and scipy 1.18.1; DRAGON2 built from source in a user work directory (no system-wide installation) with Homebrew GCC 15.2.0 (g++, gcc, gfortran), GSL 2.8 and CFITSIO 4.6.4, serial (no OpenMP); the build and each run are recorded as computational-run artifacts under tests/adapters/fixtures/cr_propagation/. The provider dragon2 runs DRAGON2 located through HEP_DRAGON2_BIN and HEP_DRAGON2_DATA and keeps each run under HEP_DRAGON2_RUN_DIR when set. No network at run time; the source was cloned once from GitHub (user-approved). USINE V3.5 built from source (gitlab.com/dmaurin/USINE tag V3.5) in a user work directory with Apple clang 21.0.0 against Homebrew ROOT 6.38.04, located through HEP_USINE_BIN and HEP_USINE_DATA (its inputs folder), runs kept under HEP_USINE_RUN_DIR when set; no USINE source or shipped input is copied into the plugin (GPL-2.0), fixtures hold only numbers computed by USINE runs and this adapter's own files. GALPROP was not obtained or run
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses, so it stays proposed while GALPROP is proposed; DRAGON2 stays tested-in-declared-environment only while its recorded runs and the live rerun (HEP_DRAGON2_LIVE_TEST=1) pass on the declared build; another DRAGON2 commit or build is a new test; USINE stays tested-in-declared-environment only while its recorded runs and the live rerun (HEP_USINE_LIVE_TEST=1) pass on the declared V3.5 build, another commit or build is a new test; a run that terminates is not a validated prediction, and the limit benchmark is a consistency check against a closed form, not a validation of the code

provider.description: one USINE V3.5 run per point (translator of the transport block, ILLUSTRATIVE cross sections of theory:cr-secondary-ratio), read into ratios of bin integrals of B/C, 10Be/9Be or Be/B on ekn or rigidity bins (r3 P2, P3); not decomposable; needs HEP_USINE_BIN and HEP_USINE_DATA

one DRAGON2 run per point (translator of the transport block, ILLUSTRATIVE isotopic cross sections), read into ratios of bin integrals of B/C or 10Be/9Be on ekn or rigidity bins (r3 P2, P3); not decomposable; needs HEP_DRAGON2_BIN and HEP_DRAGON2_DATA
